max_candidates.description: Maximum alternatives to inspect from this one query, from one through three, default 3: the front of the IK-ordered pool described under IK selection. This truncates a call-local ranking and does not select a grasp or request repeated planning.

target_ref.description: Exactly one target_ref returned by vision_ground or vision_segment for the current immutable observation; do not copy an older reference after the world or observation changes.

camera.description: Exact current native-resolution RGB-D camera in which to ground the text.

max_candidates.description: Maximum ranked regions to return, 1 to 3, default 3. Three is what the grounding service answers per call, so a larger number is refused before the request is sent rather than returned as an error you cannot act on. Every returned region gets its own close-up preview; nothing caps previews across a step, and no count of images already in the conversation refuses this call. Fewer regions answer faster: three cost roughly 479 milliseconds against 244 for one.

text.description: Short visible object or part description used to retrieve an inspectable candidate set; use task language or a concrete visual rephrasing, never a simulator identifier.
